items.name: valdrada
items.description: Valdrada is a real-time digital twin of New York City built from public data.

readme.excerpt:
Valdrada is a city-scale digital twin of New York City compiled from public municipal records. It combines a real-time WebGL2 renderer, lane-level traffic and pedestrian simulation, pixel-exact perception ground truth and a client–server API modelled on CARLA. It is intended for synthetic data generation, closed-loop scenario simulation and streetscape studies in which every modelled element can be traced to a public record.

- Documentation: - Videos: - Demo in the browser (WebGL2): - Compiled city, models and textures: - Simulation server for Windows x64, compiled city included: - Unreal Engine 5 client for Linux x86-64:

A Node.js compiler reads the city's records and writes binary tiles. Building footprints are joined to tax lots and facade filings and classified into facade typologies. Street centrelines become carriageways, kerbs, crosswalks, lane paint and the lane and sidewalk graphs. The client streams the tiles around the camera, dresses the facades, simulates vehicles and pedestrians, and renders every frame together with its labels.

Turn your regular JavaScript code into a neural net; no training, exact, yet also fully differentiable!

readme.excerpt:
Authorize every autonomous action, before it commits.

AgentSafe is the open-source gateway that puts authorization in front of every action your AI agents, workflows and pipelines take: a payment or a settlement, a trade, a price change, an inspection sign-off, a deployment or any other API call. An agent, an application or a tool sends its HTTP request to AgentSafe instead of the target; AgentSafe captures the action as an intent, asks the Decionis control plane (the Independent Execution Authority, bound to the exact action) for a decision, and forwards exactly the authorized request once on a claimed single-use grant, holds it for a person, or refuses it, leaving a chained record of each. It decides nothing itself.

items.description: Change data capture for a variety of databases. Please log issues at https://github.com/debezium/dbz/issues.

readme.excerpt:
Copyright Debezium Authors. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The Antlr grammars within the debezium-ddl-parser module are licensed under the MIT License.

Debezium is an open source project that provides a low latency data streaming platform for change data capture (CDC). You set up and configure Debezium to monitor your databases, and then your applications consume events for each row-level change made to the database. Only committed changes are visible, so your application doesn't have to worry about transactions or changes that are rolled back. Debezium provides a single model of all change events, so your application does not have to worry about the intricacies of each kind of database management system. Additionally, since Debezium records the history of data changes in durable, replicated logs, your application can be stopped and restarted at any time, and it will be able to consume all of the events it missed while it was not running, ensuring that all events are processed correctly and completely.

Monitoring databases and being notified when data changes has always been complicated. Relational database triggers can be useful, but are specific to each database and often limited to updating state within the same database (not communicating with external processes). Some databases offer APIs or frameworks for monitoring changes, but there is no standard so each database's approach is different and requires a lot of knowledged and specialized code. It stil

readme.excerpt:
$ stashcard paste a profile - pick a card - get a PNG worth posting

Stashcard values a Steam account and its inventories (CS2, Dota 2, TF2, Rust, Steam community items or any custom app) from your terminal, prices them on Steam and on the big cash marketplaces, and prints the result as a shareable card: a report card, a game card, an inventory picture, a thermal receipt, a marketplace comparison, or a then-vs-now / A-vs-B diff.

Every number carries its venue and window. LOWEST is the floor listing right now. AVG is the mean of real sales over a window you pick. Steam money is wallet funds; everything else is cash, and the two are never mixed silently. When a source has nothing, Stashcard falls back and says so on the row, in the totals and in the card footer. Nothing unpriced is ever counted as zero.

Lua scripting system platform, C++ Modding API, SDK generator, blueprint mod loader, live property editor and other dumping utilities for UE4/5 games.

items.name: NOIR
items.description: 手机隐私审计：用 adb 扫出 Android 应用的权限、上报端点与数据流向，并给出可回滚的处置。Desktop Android leak audit: permissions, endpoints, data flows, reversible fixes.

readme.excerpt:
███╗ ██╗ ██████╗ ██╗██████╗ ████╗ ██║██╔═══██╗██║██╔══██╗ ██╔██╗ ██║██║ ██║██║██████╔╝ ██║╚██╗██║██║ ██║██║██╔══██╗ ██║ ╚████║╚██████╔╝██║██║ ██║ ╚═╝ ╚═══╝ ╚═════╝ ╚═╝╚═╝ ╚═╝

NOIR 是一个跑在电脑上的审计工具，通过 adb 读取已连接 Android 设备的应用清单、权限和 APK 里的网络端点，给出分类、风险评分和可执行的处置建议。它也可以在需要时调用 jadx 对单个应用做反编译和关键字检索。

1. 盘点 ：列出所有「有网络权限 + 敏感权限」的应用，以及它们各自拿到了什么。 2. 抽取端点 ：在设备端用 unzip + strings 从每个 APK 的 dex 里提取 URL，只回传几 KB，不把整包拉回电脑。 3. 分类与打分 ：按包名和域名识别厂商（Xiaomi / Google / 腾讯 / 高德 …）与类别（遥测、广告、定位、输入法 …），结合权限和上报端点计算风险分。 4. 数据关联 ：把权限翻译成"能拿到什么数据"（位置/通讯录/短信/通话/麦克风/相机/屏幕/应用列表/设备标识/文件/日历/账号），再和上报域名配对，得出"哪类数据可能流向哪里"。 5. 共享 UID ：识别 android.uid.system 这类共享用户，列出哪些包实际上共享同一套权限并集。 6. 清单层 ：解析 AndroidManifest.xml 二进制 AXML，找出没有权限保护的导出组件、明文流量、备份、debuggable、targetSdk。 4. 给建议 ：区分「可安全自动执行」「需人工确认」「不建议动」，并为每条动作生成回滚命令。 5. 必要时深挖 ： deep 会把单个 APK 拉到本地，用 jadx 反编译后检索 Runtime.exec 、 setApplicationEnabledSetting 、 DexClassLoader 、 MediaProjection 等高风险调用。

分类与打分 ：按包名和域名识别厂商（Xiaomi / Google / 腾讯 / 高德 …）与类别（遥测、广告、定位、输入法 …），结合权限和上报端点计算风险分。
数据关联 ：把权限翻译成"能拿到什么数据"（位置/通讯录/短信/通话/麦克风/相机/屏幕/应用列表/设备标识/文件/日历/账号），再和上报域名配对，得出"哪类数据可能流向哪里"。

清单层 ：解析 AndroidManifest.xml 二进制 AXML，找出没有权限保护的导出组件、明文流量、备份、debuggable、targetSdk。

This application mirrors Android devices (video and audio) connected via USB or TCP/IP and allows control using the computer's keyboard and mouse. It does not require root access or an app installed on the device. It works on Linux , Windows , and macOS .
